text.p: Stellar Hope - (built 1996) 151,244 dwt del Continent end August trip via Hampton Roads plus Richards Bay redel South Korea $17,850 daily Halla.
Marine Corona - (built 1982) 139,000 dwt del Port Talbot early Sept about four months trading approx. $13,500 daily Cetragpa.
Koula L - (built 1977) 71,730 dwt 12.5 on 40 plus 3 del Hamburg in direct continuation prompt 2-3 laden legs redel Atlantic $8,000 daily Docenave.
Oceanic Explorer - (built 1990) 68,849 dwt 13.7 on 28 plus 0.2 del Taichung 25/30 July trip via Newcastle redel Taiwan $9,100 daily HMM.
Grischuna - (built 1987) 64,442 dwt 13 on 25 del E.Australia mid August trip Japan $9,500 daily plus $150,000 bb NYK.
Santa Rita - (built 1996) 41,515 dwt del Skaw prompt trip Singapore-Japan range $11,000 daily Pan Ocean.
Lynx - (built 1978) 29,536 dwt del St. Lawrence prompt trip Algeria $5,750 daily Canadian charterers.
